details: Stablecoin issuer Circle has obtained a limited-purpose trust charter from the New York Department of Financial Services (NYDFS) for Circle Internet Trust Company. This action expands the regulatory framework for its USDC stablecoin, complementing its prior federal approval from the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) for a national trust bank. This dual regulatory foundation is anticipated to boost the use of USDC by traditional financial institutions.
title: Circle Secures NYDFS Trust Charter for USDC.

details: Coinkite, the manufacturer of Coldcard hardware wallets, has issued a security alert for users of its Mk3 devices. The warning indicates that Bitcoin funds might be at risk if their wallet seed was generated using specific firmware versions released since March 2021 (version 4.0.1 onwards). This follows reports of approximately 594.5 BTC, valued around $38 million, being drained from 500 single-signature addresses, suggesting a vulnerability in the device's seed generation.
title: Coldcard Mk3 Users Warned After 594 BTC Swept.

details: Bitcoin's price has declined to a two-week low, dropping below $62,500, after both the U.S. Federal Reserve and the Bank of Japan decided to keep interest rates unchanged. This market movement follows a period of price volatility and rejections at higher levels, with several altcoins also experiencing notable declines.
title: Bitcoin Falls to 2-Week Low as Fed & BoJ Hold Rates.
